label: DrayTek Vigor 2865 (V2865-K)
description: VDSL/ADSL firewall router: 2x 1G WAN (one GbE/SFP combo), 6x 1G LAN.
notes: Vendor figures from the Vigor 2865 series datasheet: **WAN is 1x GbE RJ-45 plus a 1x GbE/SFP combo port**, and the LAN side is **5x Gigabit Ethernet ports plus 1x LAN switchable port** - printed in the sheet as "6 Gigabit LAN ports". The switchable port can become a third WAN, so the same chassis is 2 WAN / 6 LAN or 3 WAN / 5 LAN depending on configuration. The VDSL2 35b modem is on the DSL port, not on the Ethernet side.
